awards.name: Formal Fine Dining Restaurant of the Year

bio: Xiquet is a Michelin-starred Spanish restaurant in Washington, D.C., led by Chef Danny Lledó from Dénia in the Valencian region. Since opening in March 2020, it earned a Michelin star in 2021 and the AAA Five Diamond award in 2022, establishing itself as one of the city’s premier fine-dining destinations. The restaurant offers a tasting menu of over 16 meticulously crafted courses that showcase modern interpretations of Valencian cuisine. Signature dishes include Alicante-style rice with rabbit and mushrooms, prepared over a wood-fired hearth, alongside innovative small plates highlighting local and seasonal ingredients. Guests begin the experience at the Chef’s Counter with a welcome bite and a sip of vermouth before embarking on the multi-course journey, observing the artistry and precision behind each dish. Xiquet balances refinement with warmth, blending elegant presentation, thoughtful technique, and deep respect for Spanish culinary heritage. Each course reflects Lledó’s commitment to flavor, quality, and storytelling through food. With its immersive tasting experience, celebration of seasonal ingredients, and focus on Valencian roots, Xiquet continues to draw diners seeking an authentic, elevated Spanish culinary adventure.
